plan.subject: LLM agents

queries.query: ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent" OR "autonomous agent") AND ("task planning" OR "hierarchical planning" OR "plan decomposition")
queries.rationale: Captures foundational papers on how agents structure, break down, and sequence complex tasks.

queries.query: ("autonomous agent" OR "generative agent") AND ("tool use" OR "function calling" OR "tool calling" OR "API integration")
queries.rationale: Targets research on external tool invocation, schema handling, and API orchestration techniques.

queries.query: ("LLM agent" OR "AI agent") AND ("agent memory" OR "external memory" OR "context retrieval" OR "episodic memory")
queries.rationale: Finds work on how agents store, retrieve, and update state across long-running sessions.

queries.query: ("multi-agent system" OR "agent collaboration" OR "agent debate") AND ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent")
queries.rationale: Surfaces studies on agent-to-agent communication, role assignment, and consensus mechanisms.

queries.query: ("language model agent" OR "autonomous agent") AND ("self-reflection" OR "self-correction" OR "reflexion" OR "iterative refinement")
queries.rationale: Retrieves papers on feedback loops that enable agents to critique and fix their own outputs.

queries.query: ("LLM agent" OR "AI agent") AND ("SWE-bench" OR "AgentBench" OR "WebShop" OR "agent benchmark")
queries.rationale: Focuses on empirical evaluation frameworks and standardized test suites for agent capabilities.

queries.query: ("autonomous agent" OR "generative agent") AND ("chain of thought" OR "tree of thoughts" OR "graph of thoughts" OR "reasoning path")
queries.rationale: Targets advanced prompting and search-space exploration methods that improve agent logic.

queries.query: ("coding agent" OR "software repair" OR "automated debugging") AND ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent")
queries.rationale: Catches applied research on code generation, repository-level understanding, and bug fixing.

queries.query: ("LLM agent" OR "autonomous agent") AND ("safety guardrail" OR "output verification" OR "hallucination mitigation" OR "alignment constraint")
queries.rationale: Identifies engineering-focused work on preventing harmful actions, enforcing constraints, and verifying outputs.

queries.query: ("AI agent" OR "software agent") AND ("inference optimization" OR "token caching" OR "speculative decoding" OR "model distillation")
queries.rationale: Surfaces techniques for reducing latency and compute costs in production agent pipelines.

queries.query: ("language model agent" OR "autonomous agent") AND ("web navigation" OR "browser automation" OR "GUI interaction" OR "screen parsing")
queries.rationale: Targets agents designed to interact with browsers, parse DOMs, and control graphical interfaces.

queries.query: ("LLM agent" OR "generative agent") AND ("human-in-the-loop" OR "interactive feedback" OR "agent orchestration" OR "workflow management")
queries.rationale: Finds research on workflow engines, supervisor patterns, and human intervention points.

queries.query: ("autonomous agent" OR "AI agent") AND ("prompt engineering" OR "instruction tuning" OR "agent prompting" OR "few-shot adaptation")
queries.rationale: Covers systematic methods for shaping agent behavior through instruction design and tuning.

queries.query: ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent") AND ("retrieval-augmented generation" OR "RAG pipeline" OR "vector search" OR "knowledge retrieval")
queries.rationale: Targets integration of external knowledge bases and vector stores to ground agent responses.

queries.query: ("software agent" OR "autonomous agent") AND ("parallel execution" OR "concurrent planning" OR "asynchronous workflow" OR "multi-step execution")
queries.rationale: Retrieves engineering studies on parallelizing agent tasks and managing asynchronous state transitions.

plan.coverage_notes: The plan covers core agent architecture, tool integration, memory, multi-agent collaboration, self-correction, benchmarking, reasoning strategies, code-specific applications, safety, deployment optimization, web automation, orchestration, prompting, RAG, and concurrency. Purely theoretical alignment or philosophical papers are deliberately minimized in favor of engineering-grounded techniques, evaluation frameworks, and production constraints. Subject phrasing is varied across queries to capture inconsistent terminology in the literature while maintaining tight precision through dual-specificity AND structures.
